scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/react -w packages/vue
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w examples/core -w examples/react -w examples/vue
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/vue/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/vue/tsconfig.json
